name: @pipeworx/mcp-studio-ghibli

tools.name: films
tools.description: List all Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning title, director, producer, release year, running time, Rotten Tomatoes score, and related character/location/vehicle URLs.

tools.name: people
tools.description: List Studio Ghibli characters (up to optional limit), returning name, gender, age, eye/hair color, species, and the films they appear in.

tools.name: locations
tools.description: List fictional locations from Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning name, climate, terrain, surface water, and the films they appear in.

tools.name: species
tools.description: List species that appear in Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning name, classification, eye/hair colors, and the films and characters associated with that species.

tools.name: vehicles
tools.description: List vehicles from Studio Ghibli films (up to optional limit), returning name, description, vehicle class, length, pilot, and the film it appears in.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-studio-ghibli forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the studio-ghibli pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
